system.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls use your Ranged Proficiency, and every Talent here counts toward your Ranged rank. You gain the Keep Moving ❶ action.
Keep Moving ❶ Stance
Requirements You wield a sling or a weapon with the Thrown trait.
While in this stance:
if you make a ranged Strike, you may Step immediately before or after it;
you may use this benefit only once per round.
